bibl.title: Paul Not Yet Justified? The Text of Philippians 3:12 in P46.
bibl.seg: Ryan Kristopher Giffin, Paul Not Yet Justified? The Text of Philippians 3:12 in P46.
TC: A Journal of Biblical Textual Criticism 25 (2020) pp. 37-47.
bibl.note: Four noteworthy features of the justification clause of Phil 3:12 in P46 [= P. Chester Beatty II Suppl. + P. Mich. Inv. 6238 (= van Haelst 497; LDAB 3011)]. - The justification clause of Phil 3:12 in P46 and final justification at the last judgment. - Conclusion.
